messages.snippet: James - when you get a moment, the Caspian Technologies commercial contract team need a quick steer
messages.subject: Caspian - data processing schedule
messages.plaintextBody:
James - when you get a moment, the Caspian Technologies commercial contract team need a quick steer on the DPA schedule for the Brookmere master subscription agreement. Nothing to do with Indigo - just flagging as Daniel is away and they asked for you. Can you ping Elena to help?

Sarah
